name: HIAC Tetrahedra Mode Parallelism
definition: A parallel volume rendering method for meshes composed of tetrahedra, using Pthreads for shared-memory processing on SGI systems. It involves sorting cells by visibility, projecting them onto the view plane, decomposing projections into triangles, and rendering via OpenGL.
summary: HIAC Tetrahedra Mode Parallelism is a parallel volume rendering method for tetrahedral meshes that uses a buffer-swapping mechanism with a dedicated Communicator thread, distinguishing it from asynchronous task queues.
